primary_source.title: Eric Lauga, Propulsion in a viscoelastic fluid, Physics of Fluids 19, 083104 (2007)

independent_reasoning: Complex harmonic two-height velocity identifies viscosity with explicit no-phase-wrap bound.
Planar symmetric traceless strain anticommutator is isotropic, so a corotational source cannot separate quadratic pumping.
recommendation: A compact finite-inertia prototype is worthwhile; no package yet. The linear laboratory Jeffreys approximation needs explicit private objectivity qualification.
